title: Proving the Coding Interview: A Benchmark for Formally Verified Code Generation
paper_type_zh: 形式化验证代码生成基准与 Lean 4 数据集
best_for_zh: 需要联合评测程序实现、形式规格与 Lean 证明生成的研究者。
one_line: FVAPPS reformulates coding-interview problems as Lean 4 programming-and-proof tasks, with compilation and theorem checking as the final verifier.
FVAPPS 将编程面试题改写为 Lean 4 的程序与证明任务，以编译和定理检查共同验证最终结果。
why: It requires an agent to satisfy a machine-checked specification rather than only pass conventional unit tests.
inclusion_reason: FVAPPS pairs program synthesis with a Lean theorem whose acceptance is a deterministic final-outcome signal.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Coding-interview benchmarks such as APPS use finite unit tests for Python programs. They catch some errors but do not prove correctness for all inputs, while formal theorem-proving datasets rarely require both writing a program and proving it. Models may pass examples without translating natural-language requirements into contracts and machine-checked proofs.

FVAPPS translates APPS problems into Lean 4 files. Each task retains a natural-language description and provides a function signature, #eval examples, and one or more correctness theorems left with sorry. A model may fill proofs only or implement both functions and proofs. The Lean compiler and kernel provide final verification, upgrading a test-based coding benchmark into formally verified program synthesis.

APPS 等 coding interview benchmark 用有限单元测试检查 Python 程序，能够发现部分错误，却不能证明实现对所有输入满足规格；形式定理证明数据又很少同时要求“写程序”和“证明程序”。模型可能生成通过样例的代码，但缺乏把自然语言需求转成函数契约并完成机器证明的能力。

FVAPPS 将 APPS 编程题翻译为 Lean 4 文件：每题保留自然语言描述，给出待实现函数签名、#eval 示例以及一个或多个以 sorry 留空的正确性定理。模型既可只补 proof，也可同时实现函数与证明；最终由 Lean 编译器和内核验证，从测试式 coding benchmark 提升到形式化程序合成。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is the Formally Verified Automated Programming Progress Standards (FVAPPS): 4,715 Lean 4 programming-and-proof tasks, including 1,083 more carefully curated and quality-controlled samples. JSON or Lean records may include the original APPS statement, function skeleton, executable #eval or #guard_msgs examples, theorem holes, difficulty, and quality tags. Lean 4.12.0 is the fixed generation and baseline version. Unlike proof sets containing only theorem statements, FVAPPS jointly evaluates program synthesis and correctness proofs. The public dataset is about 46.8 MB under MIT and supports proof SFT, verified-code generation, and Lean-kernel rewards.

核心贡献是 Formally Verified Automated Programming Progress Standards（FVAPPS）：4,715 个 Lean 4 编程—证明任务，其中 1,083 条经过更严格人工整理和质量控制。每个 JSON/Lean 记录可包含原 APPS 题目、函数定义骨架、可执行 #eval/#guard_msgs 示例、待证明 theorem、难度和质量标记；Lean 4.12.0 是官方生成与 baseline 的固定版本。与只给 theorem statement 的证明集不同，FVAPPS 同时评测 program synthesis 和 correctness proof；公开数据约 46.8 MB、MIT 许可，可用于 proof SFT、verified code generation 和 Lean kernel reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select APPS problems: Parse natural-language statements, Python references, and tests, retaining problems expressible with Lean data types and without heavy external-library or I/O dependence.
  1. Translate program interfaces: Convert input and output types and algorithm skeletons into Lean 4 functions, add executable #eval examples, and compile-check syntax, types, and outputs.
  1. Generate correctness theorems: Generalize unit tests into variable-bearing theorems or properties and leave proof portions as sorry. Manually inspect the quality-controlled subset for non-triviality and alignment with the problem.
  1. Release task files: Preserve program holes, proof holes, and metadata; accept model outputs only when they compile and pass the Lean 4.12.0 kernel. Reproduction must pin Lean and report the full 4,715 and curated 1,083 subsets separately.

1. 选择 APPS 题目： 解析自然语言、Python 参考代码和测试，筛选适合用 Lean 数据类型表达且不严重依赖外部库或 I/O 的问题。
  1. 翻译程序接口： 将输入输出类型和算法骨架转换为 Lean 4 函数，加入可执行 #eval 示例；编译检查语法、类型和示例输出。
  1. 生成正确性定理： 把单元测试推广为带变量的 theorem 或性质，用 sorry 留出待证明部分；质量控制子集人工检查 statement 是否非平凡并与题意一致。
  1. 发布任务级文件： 保留 program hole、proof hole 和元数据，模型输出后由 Lean 4.12.0 编译/内核验收。复现需固定 Lean pin，并分别报告全部 4,715 与 curated 1,083 子集。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors randomly sample 100 of the 4,715 tasks, containing 406 theorems, and compare proprietary models on direct proof completion. In a fixed Lean environment, Claude Sonnet proves about 30% and Gemini about 18%, showing executable but challenging tasks; failures include theorem misunderstanding, library retrieval, and non-compiling proofs. The 1,083 curated records provide a more reliable evaluation surface, but the paper does not report controlled external-benchmark gains after large-scale FVAPPS training. Evidence supports automated Lean evaluation of program proofs, not that all 4,715 theorems fully capture original APPS requirements, and 30% is proof-only rather than end-to-end program-plus-proof success.

作者从 4,715 条中随机抽取 100 个样本、共 406 个 theorem，比较闭源模型直接补证明。在固定 Lean 环境中，Claude Sonnet 正确证明约 30%，Gemini 约 18%，说明任务既可运行又具有明显难度；大量错误来自定理理解、库检索和生成不可编译 proof。1,083 条 curated 记录提供更可靠评测面，但论文未展示用 FVAPPS 大规模训练后对外部 benchmark 的受控增益。现有证据支持“数据能用 Lean 自动评测程序证明”，不能证明所有 4,715 个 theorem 都充分表达原 APPS 需求，也不能把 30% 视为端到端程序+证明成功率。

title: Novelty
新意
html: APPS asks Python code to pass tests, while Lean datasets such as MiniF2F ask for proofs of given mathematical theorems; existing verified-coding sets are much smaller. FVAPPS places function implementation and property proof from technical-interview problems in one Lean file. #eval retains concrete behavior checks, while theorems lift finite tests into universal specifications. Translating Python to Lean and using sorry benchmarks are not individually new. The change is systematic conversion of 4,715 general programming tasks into unified implementation-plus-proof obligations, with a 1,083-task quality-controlled subset.

APPS 只要求 Python 代码通过测试，MiniF2F 等 Lean 集只要求证明给定数学定理；已有 verified coding 小集规模又较小。FVAPPS 的变化是把技术面试题中的函数实现与性质证明放进同一个 Lean 文件，用 #eval 保留具体行为检查，同时用 theorem 把有限测试提升为全称规范。它不是首次将 Python 翻译成 Lean，也不是首次使用 sorry benchmark，而是把 4,715 个通用编程任务系统转成“实现 + proof obligation”的统一数据对象，并提供 1,083 条质量控制子集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Weak or incorrect specifications: Automatically generalizing tests can create partial, tautological, or misaligned theorems; the authors note that theorem desirability still needs judgment. Prefer the curated subset and audit specifications with humans or counterexamples.
  1. sorry and compilability: Source files compile with sorry, which does not mean a model completed the proof. Evaluation must disable or scan sorry, admit, and unsafe axioms and confirm that target theorems are closed.
  1. Translation distribution: Converting Python and I/O problems to Lean data structures may remove performance constraints and original runtime semantics. All 4,715 tasks derive from public APPS, creating contamination risk. Reuse should pin Lean 4.12.0, deduplicate source problems, and report program and proof success separately.

1. 规格可能过弱或错误： 从测试自动推广 theorem 容易产生只覆盖局部行为、恒真或与题意不完全对应的命题；作者也指出 theorem desirability 仍需判断。应优先使用 curated 子集，并人工/反例审计规格。
  1. sorry 与可编译性： 原文件可因 sorry 编译，不代表模型完成了证明；评测必须禁用或扫描 sorry、admit 和不安全公理，并确认目标 theorem 真正关闭。
  1. 翻译分布： APPS 的 Python/I/O 题被转换为 Lean 数据结构，性能约束和真实运行语义可能丢失；4,715 条也来自公开 APPS，存在预训练污染。复用应固定 Lean 4.12.0、按原题去重并分别报告 program/proof success。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Proof-completion evaluation: Pin the official Lean version, replace only theorem sorry holes, measure compilation success, and stratify by curated status, difficulty, and theorem count while scanning for cheating constructs.
  1. Verified-code SFT or RLVR: Train models to generate functions and proofs and use Lean diagnostics as feedback. Rewards can be staged across syntax, type checking, example execution, and theorem closure.
  1. Specification-quality research: Compare original APPS tests, #eval checks, and universal theorems, generating counterexamples to test specification adequacy. For runtime performance, system APIs, or multi-file repositories, FVAPPS’s pure-function Lean representation is insufficient and needs real execution environments.

1. proof completion 评测： 固定官方 Lean pin，只替换 theorem 的 sorry，统计编译通过率，并按 curated、难度和 theorem 数分层；同时扫描作弊关键字。
  1. verified code SFT/RLVR： 训练模型生成函数和 proof，使用 Lean 编译日志作为反馈，reward 可分为语法、类型检查、样例执行和 theorem closure 四级。
  1. 规格质量研究： 比较原 APPS 测试、#eval 和通用 theorem，生成反例检查 theorem 是否充分。若目标是运行性能、系统 API 或多文件仓库，FVAPPS 的纯函数 Lean 表示不够，应另加真实执行环境。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: FVAPPS converts 4,715 APPS problems into Lean 4 implementation-and-proof tasks, including 1,083 quality-controlled records.
  1. Method takeaway: Python and API translation, #eval behavior checks, theorem generation, sorry holes, and Lean 4.12.0 kernel acceptance form the pipeline.
  1. Data takeaway: Records may contain statements, function skeletons, examples, proof obligations, and quality tags; full and curated sets must be reported separately.
  1. Evidence anchor: On 406 theorems from 100 tasks, Sonnet proves about 30% and Gemini about 18%, showing that proof completion remains difficult.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits verified program and proof training. Weak theorems and sorry exploitation require counterexample audits and kernel-level scanning.

1. 一句话定位： FVAPPS 把 4,715 道 APPS 题转成 Lean 4 程序实现与证明任务，其中 1,083 条经质量控制。
  1. 方法抓手： Python/API 翻译、#eval 行为检查、theorem 生成、sorry 留空和 Lean 4.12.0 内核验收构成流程。
  1. 数据抓手： 每条可含题目、函数骨架、样例、proof obligation 和质量标记；完整集与 curated 子集需分开报告。
  1. 证据锚点： 100 个样本的 406 个 theorem 上，Sonnet 证明约 30%，Gemini 约 18%，表明 proof completion 仍难。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 verified program/proof 训练；最大风险是弱 theorem 与 sorry 作弊，必须做规格反例和内核扫描。
